name: Neynar
description: Farcaster social-graph and cast data through a hosted API. x402-gated at $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, so an agent can pull profiles, casts and follower data without an API key or a prepaid tier.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: No account needed on the x402 path. A request without an API key returns 402 quoting 0.01 USDC on Base; sign EIP-3009 (gasless transferWithAuthorization) and retry. API-key plans remain available for higher volume.
